annotations.title: Bitcoin fee rates and mempool status

description: Current Bitcoin network fee rates in sat/vB for next-block, half-hour, one-hour and economy confirmation, the estimated cost in sats of a typical payment, mempool size and total pending fees, and the latest block height. Use before sending a Bitcoin transaction or to decide whether to wait for lower fees. Price $0.002/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

only.description: Optional: comma-separated top-level result keys to keep, for a smaller answer (for example only=price,symbol); unknown keys are ignored and an empty match returns the full result

name: btc_fees

checkedAt.description: Server retrieval time in UTC. Upstream endpoints are not an atomic snapshot.

typicalPaymentVbytes.description: Illustrative transaction-size assumption; not the buyer's transaction size.
